title: The Missing Ribbon
summary: Sabine's blue festival ribbon vanished from its hook two nights ago.

evidence.title: Tracks by the hook
evidence.text: Small four-toed prints in the mud under the empty hook.

evidence.title: Blue thread
evidence.text: Strands of blue silk snagged at knee height on the bakery post.

evidence.title: Knocked-over bins
evidence.text: Maren says something knocked her bins over in the night; she blamed the cats.

evidence.title: A very blue rat
evidence.text: Bram saw a fox by Reed House carrying something, heading south-east.

evidence.title: The ribbon
evidence.text: Found in a fox den near the heron pool.

hypotheses.text: Maren took it to win the stall
hypotheses.reaction: It's a theory. The thread was at knee height, though.
Tracks, a witness, and a trail heading south-east.
Possible. Sabine won't like hearing it.
